sentences.text:
2 15-05-2024 Heard Mr. Ravi Shankar Pathak, learned counsel for the petitioner and Ms. Vijya Raj Lakshmi representing the informant.
2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Simri P.S. Case No. 442 of 2023 for the offence under Sections 341, 323, 494, 498A, 506/34 of the I.P.C. lodged on 27.12.2023 by the informant, Reema Devi.
3.
As per the prosecution story, the petitioner solemnized marriage in the year 1997 with the opposite party no. 2.
Since, the couple did not had any issue, with consent the informant brother's daughter was adopted.
However, later the petitioner went into live in relationship and thereafter forced her Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.28759 of 2024(2) dt.15-05-2024 to leave the house and when she tried to enter, one Gunja Devi was present there and she alongwith the husband assaulted/forced her to leave, left with no alternative, the FIR.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that all the allegations are false, there was some issue with the adopted girl who had sold the land, litigation was there, in any case he is ready to keep his Bigan Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21858824/
1 wife with all dignity and honour.

entities.text: Bigan Singh vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The last submission is that since she is a legally wedded wife, living separately, he shall be paying Rs. 5,000/- per month in her bank account and to start with he will be paying Rs. 5,000/- by 31/05/2024 and from June, 2024 shall be paying the amount by 15th of every month.
5. Learned counsel for the informant has also consented that the matter be sent to the mediation center.
6. With the consent of the parties, let the matter go before the Mediation Center where the couple will appear on 24.06.2024 and a report be submitted on 24.07.2024.
7. In the meantime, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner in connection with Simri P.S. Case No. 442 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned J.M. First Class, Court No. 12 at Buxar.

entities.text: J.M. First Class, Court No. 12 at Buxar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 8. The petitioner further undertakes to pay Rs. 2,000/- Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.28759 of 2024(2) dt.15-05-2024 to the informant as the conveyance charge on the day she will visit the Mediation Center.

9. List this case on 24.07.2024.
(Rajiv Roy, J) Adnan/-
